title: Degenerate band-edge envelope derivation
question: Starting from a specified finite-range lattice with a quartic band minimum, determine whether a fourth-order nonlinear envelope equation follows under controlled modulation scaling.
first_test: Derive an approximation theorem with explicit amplitude and time exponents.

title: Discrete-to-continuum confinement persistence
question: Determine whether localized lattice equilibria converge to genuine confined solutions of a fourth-order continuum energy as lattice spacing vanishes.
first_test: Prove compactness and identify the continuum limiting equation.

title: Uniform modulation error over long times
question: For a weakly nonlinear multiscale wave ansatz, determine whether the approximation error stays small over a power-law-in-epsilon time horizon.
first_test: Prove a uniform error bound or a resonant failure example.

title: Microscopic origin of cubic–quintic saturation
question: Classify lattice onsite potentials whose small-amplitude envelope expansion has focusing cubic and defocusing quintic coefficients with fixed signs.
first_test: Derive the expansion and identify an explicit nonempty coupling region.

title: Scale separation near an avoided crossing
question: For a two-band oscillator lattice, determine which detuning scalings produce a closed scalar rather than vector envelope equation.
first_test: Prove a reduced model and quantify mode-leakage error.

title: Effective geometric curvature from microstructure
question: Determine whether anisotropic microscopic coupling generates a nontrivial curvature-dependent effective operator in the continuum limit.
first_test: Derive the operator and give a convergence or homogenization theorem.

title: Homogenization of periodically patterned media
question: For a fourth-order wave equation with rapidly oscillating coefficients, identify the homogenized dispersion and its preferred wavelength.
first_test: Prove resolvent or evolution convergence with boundary-layer corrections.

title: Disorder-induced failure of effective equations
question: Determine the threshold of random microscopic disorder beyond which a deterministic envelope approximation ceases to hold on fixed mesoscopic times.
first_test: Prove an error breakdown or convergence in probability.

title: Boundary-layer corrections to wave confinement
question: Derive leading corrections to confined profiles when a continuum limit is taken near a physical boundary.
first_test: Prove a matched asymptotic expansion with controlled remainders.

title: Finite-size scaling of confinement thresholds
question: Determine how the threshold mass for localized states in finite lattice domains converges to its infinite-volume value.
first_test: Prove finite-size error estimates and characterize boundary dependence.

title: Conservation law transfer across model scales
question: Determine whether microscopic Hamiltonian invariants converge to the mass and energy invariants of a nonlinear continuum envelope.
first_test: Prove asymptotic conservation with quantified defect terms.

title: Noncommuting continuum and long-time limits
question: Determine whether taking lattice spacing to zero before time to infinity yields a different confinement conclusion than reversing the order.
first_test: Construct a counterexample or prove commutation under explicit uniform estimates.

title: Strong versus weak convergence of physical observables
question: Determine which experimental observables converge strongly when microscopic states only converge weakly to an effective wave field.
first_test: Prove a measurement-stability theorem for a specified observable.

title: Inverse calibration of effective coupling coefficients
question: Determine whether continuum cubic–quintic coupling constants can be uniquely recovered from a finite set of microscopic scattering tests.
first_test: Prove an identifiability result or explicit aliasing.

title: Multiscale topological charge preservation
question: Determine whether a lattice topological invariant converges to the winding or Hopf degree of a continuum field.
first_test: Prove charge stability under a nonvanishing interpolation hypothesis.

title: Error bounds for reduced three-dimensional models
question: For a thin physical waveguide, justify reducing a full three-dimensional wave equation to a two-dimensional effective fourth-order model.
first_test: Prove confinement of transverse modes and a dimension-reduction error.

title: Competing effective Hamiltonians from the same lattice
question: Determine whether two mathematically distinct nonlinear continuum models can produce identical leading-order predictions for one microscopic wave system.
first_test: Construct an equivalence class or identify discriminating higher-order terms.

title: Emergent wave speed and stiffness constants
question: Determine which microscopic stiffness parameters control group velocity and fourth-order dispersion in the continuum wave approximation.
first_test: Prove a coefficient-identification formula and stability bounds.

title: Breakdown of adiabatic mode elimination
question: Determine when a fast auxiliary mode in a coupled wave system cannot be eliminated without losing energy stability or predictive accuracy.
first_test: Construct a resonance counterexample and bound error away from resonance.

title: Uniform regularity from microscopic energy bounds
question: Determine whether lattice energy and mass estimates yield continuum H2 regularity uniformly as spacing tends to zero.
first_test: Prove a discrete Sobolev bound or identify concentration counterexamples.

title: Experimental falsification thresholds for envelope laws
question: Given a proposed effective wave equation, determine the minimum measurement resolution required to distinguish it from a specified alternative model.
first_test: Prove a noise-dependent distinguishability margin.

title: Rigorous correspondence between lattice and optical phases
question: For a phase-modulated photonic lattice, determine how phase-shifter settings map to coefficients in a slowly varying effective field equation.
first_test: Derive an invertible calibration map or show parameter nonidentifiability.

title: Long-wavelength stability versus microscopic instabilities
question: Determine whether spectral stability of an effective envelope guarantees stability of its corresponding microscopic lattice wave.
first_test: Prove transfer with a spectral-gap assumption or exhibit an invisible short-wave instability.
